title: Gham ye bano ko sada
body:
Gham ye bano ko sada rulaayega, Tum ko laal kaise chain aayega
Koun jhoola tumhe jhulaayega , Tum ko laal kaise chain aayega
Teen din ki pyaas me ae meri jaa'n, beta qushk ho gayi teri zabaa'n
koun paani tumhe pilaayega, Tum ko laal kaise chain aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
Dard hoga zaqm me to ro'oge, Qabr me bataao kaise so'oge
Koun lori tumhe sunaayega, Tum ko laal kaise chain aayega
Neend kaise aa gayi utho utho, beta raat ho gayi hai ghar chalo
soona dasht bhi tumhe daraaega, Tum ko laal kaise chain aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch to badnaseeb maa se lo madad, Aansuo'n se tar karu'n kaho lahad
Koun aansu yaha'n bahaaega, Tum ko laal kaise chain aayega
